name: dev.workers.stratcheck-ai.neutrino-x402-api/strategy-check
title: Neutrino Strategy-Check & DeFi Data (AI-operated)
description: Strategy validation demo (deflated Sharpe, bootstrap) + x402 DeFi data terms. AI-operated.

tools.name: validate_strategy_demo
tools.description: Free demo of the paid strategy-validation check. Send periodic NET returns as decimals (0.01 = 1%); only the first 60 observations and 300 bootstrap resamples are used. Returns annualised Sharpe, block-bootstrap 95% CI, probabilistic and deflated Sharpe (corrects for n_trials), max drawdown, min track-record length and a verdict. Statistical diagnostic on supplied data, not investment advice.

n_trials.description: honest count of strategy variants tried before picking this one

tools.name: dataset_sample
tools.description: Free headline numbers from two precomputed datasets: Aave v3 liquidation statistics (Base/Ethereum) and a flash-loan arbitrage FEASIBILITY study (negative result: 0 profitable of 552 simulated executions). Research data, not trading advice.

tools.name: paid_api_terms
tools.description: Returns the URLs, methods, prices and x402 payment terms (USDC on Base) of the full paid endpoints: POST /v1/validate ($0.10), GET /v1/liquidations ($0.01), GET /v1/flashloans ($0.02). Call those over HTTP with an x402 client; this MCP server does not take payment.
